THESIS STATUS: WEAKENED
ADJUSTED CONFIDENCE: 45%
OVERNIGHT SUMMARY: Market sentiment has shifted more positive than expected with futures up across the board, particularly Nasdaq +0.70%. However, VIX surge to 24.79 (+3.85%) and negative GEX regime suggest underlying tension remains.
KEY DEVELOPMENTS: 
• S&P futures +0.40%, Nasdaq +0.70% - contradicts bearish call
• VIX spiked 3.85% to 24.79 despite positive equity futures (concerning divergence)
• Explosive volatility regime confirmed (confidence 23.2%)
• Negative GEX at -$517M with put wall at 650, call wall at 660
• Asian markets mixed: Japan +0.55%, China -1.00%
• Polymarket macro still bearish at -15.54%

TRADE RECOMMENDATION STATUS: ADJUST
TRADE NOTES: Consider exiting bull call spread at open if premium can be recovered. VIX/equity divergence suggests potential intraday reversal. Current futures at 6633 vs 656 strike suggests significant gap risk on underlying.

DAY AHEAD RISKS:
• VIX/equity futures divergence indicating hidden stress
• Explosive volatility regime could trigger sharp reversals
• Negative GEX environment amplifies moves in both directions
• Gap up may reverse if volume doesn't support

DAY AHEAD OPPORTUNITIES: 
• High VIX provides premium for option selling strategies
• Negative GEX creates potential for momentum plays
• Put wall at 650 could provide support if market rolls over
• Volatility spike may create attractive entry points for contrarian plays
